entries.claim: Current bounded collation of the complete selected 27-word Gradual against the pinned independently maintained Latin data; the adjacent Alleluia is excluded. The evidence digest identifies the complete Sancti/09-14 archive, not just this body.

locator.section: Feria V in Cena Domini, Graduale, Phil. 2, 8-9

entries.claim: Holy Thursday prints this Gradual in full. Its letters, accents and marks equal page 669 and the selected text but for one: a colon after illum (exaltávit illum : et dedit), where page 669 and the selected text have a comma (exaltávit illum, et dedit); page 669 continues with the Alleluia, which is not part of this text.
The cited page image prints and identifies the complete 1962 liturgical component selected here; shared expansions are bounded in the witness record.
